body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose yourself or one adjacent ally. The target gains +1 Defense until your next turn.

surges.html: Remove Chilled, Shocked, or Concussed from yourself.

rider.title: BULWARK ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Layered Hide. While maintained: The first time each round equipment or an effect would reduce your Defense, ignore 1 point of that reduction.
